subject.title: feat(google-meet): retain the full caption transcript per session (#103387)

question: After repeated-utterance loss is fixed, should Google Meet expose a runtime-memory-only transcript API that loses data on gateway restart and evicts content after 2000 lines?
rationale: The source defect is repairable, but transcript durability is a user-visible product contract that implementation evidence cannot decide.

options.title: Approve bounded memory
options.body: Accept the documented volatile transcript after repeated utterances are preserved and live behavior is proven.

options.title: Require SQLite durability
options.body: Defer the public retrieval API until plugin-owned persistence and restart recovery are implemented.

options.title: Defer full transcript
options.body: Keep the existing recent transcript surface and postpone complete transcript retrieval.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded memory
recommendation.body: Accept the documented volatile transcript after repeated utterances are preserved and live behavior is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: Feature history ties this person to the Google Meet plugin, caption observer, and recent session-runtime behavior.
